not_evaluable.glm-5.3-ark: MALICE hard-codes thinking disabled, which this model rejects (HTTP 400). With a patched copy (experiments/v064/malice_patches.diff) responses were truncated at max_tokens=12000 before the invariant, and calls timed out at 24000/30000. No glm data is reported.

unmodified_code: All reported results use the pinned repository files unmodified (main.py checked identical); configuration only. Required layout fix: a hash-verified copy of loopinv at <bin>/test/build/loopinv because refinement code hard-codes that path.
